subject: Vendr profile maintenance + bulk QA import request
body:
From: Lauren Myers <l.myers@acme.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile update + CAIQ batch import

Hi Alex —

Quick one: Acme is doing a quarterly vendor reassessment and Vendr asked us to refresh the profile that Redwood maintains in their portal. They can take a CAIQ bulk import if we can provide a CSV/Excel + any supporting evidence links (SOC 2, auditor letter). Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) provide the CAIQ answers spreadsheet, and 2) hand off an S3 manifest with the evidence PDFs for ingestion?

Also cc'ing Vendr onboarding here so they see the ask. Our timeline is tight — they want ingestion by Friday so the portal shows the current attestation to our procurement team.

Thanks,
Lauren
Sr. Procurement Manager — Acme Corp

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Myers <l.myers@acme.com>, Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile update + CAIQ batch import

Thanks Lauren — I can take point on this from Redwood's side. Monica, can you confirm we have: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (2026)
- CAIQ answers export (schema Vendr accepts)
- S3 manifest that maps files to CAIQ question ids

If Monica can produce the files I will push them to Vendr. If we need a short (<= 1 page) curation note for any non-standard answers, I can draft that. Deadline is Friday (25th) EOD Pacific.

Marissa — could you stand by for any procurement questions from Acme once the portal shows the updated attestation?

Alex
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs referenced: SOC2_Report_REDWOOD_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II), CAIQ_answers_2027.xlsx (Vendr import-ready), s3_evidence_manifest.json

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Myers <l.myers@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: CAIQ export + S3 manifest for Acme (reference: HubSpot REC-44932)

Hi Vendr team —

Per the thread above, attaching the CAIQ answers file and an S3 manifest for ingestion into the Vendr portal. Notes:

- CAIQ_answers_2027.xlsx: column mapping in tab "README" (question_id, answer, rationale, evidence_key)
- SOC2_Report_REDWOOD_2026.pdf: full auditor report (redacted PII where required)
- s3_evidence_manifest.json: lists objects under s3://redwood-evidence/acme/ with sha256 and logical keys that match evidence_key in the CAIQ spreadsheet

Edge cases / known items to surface for ingestion:
- Q8.2 (subprocessor list): we include a short rationalization and reference to our vendor page (see drive link).
- Q14.1 (data retention): some entries are 'see policy' and point to our retention policy doc; we can provide a one-page summary if Vendr needs inline text.

We are happy to handle the import; please confirm the exact format Vendr will consume for the manifest (JSON vs CSV) and whether you need the S3 objects made public temporarily or if you accept an IAM role for read access.

Drive link for supporting docs: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwood-CAIQ
HubSpot ref: REC-44932

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced):
- SOC2_Report_REDWOOD_2026.pdf (application/pdf)
- CAIQ_answers_2027.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- s3_evidence_manifest.json (application/json)

---

From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Myers <l.myers@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: CAIQ export + S3 manifest for Acme (reference: HubSpot REC-44932)

Hi all —

Thanks — we received the CAIQ import file and the manifest. A couple quick confirmations before we ingest to the Acme portal: 

1) We can consume the attached spreadsheet as-is, but please confirm that evidence_key in the sheet maps 1:1 to the manifest entries.
2) For S3 access, please either: (a) provide a temporary presigned-url package for each object (best for short deadlines), or (b) grant the role vendr-onboarding@vendr-iam with GetObject on the prefix. Which do you prefer?
3) We noted the SOC 2 doc has an appendix with redactions — that is acceptable, but please upload the unredacted auditor letter to the manifest under evidence_key: "auditor_letter" if possible (redactions are fine for public portal, letter required for procurement review).

If you can confirm 1+3 and choose an access method for #2 we will schedule the import for 6/25 11:00 PT. After ingestion we will send a short import log and a portal snapshot URL for Acme procurement to review.

Best,
Vendr Onboarding Team
onboarding@vendr.io

---

Summary of next steps (internal):
- Monica: finalize manifest and decide on presigned URLs vs IAM read role (deadline: 6/24 EOD).
- Alex: if Monica chooses presigned URLs, coordinate delivery to onboarding@vendr.io and confirm import window.
- Marissa: stand by to respond to Acme procurement questions after portal snapshot is ready.
